children: Venture Global subsidiary VGLNG entered into a senior secured 364-day revolving credit facility for up to $3.0 billion to support general corporate purposes. The facility, administered by Bank of America and backed by a first-priority lien on substantially all VGLNG assets, matures on Sep 1, 2027. Borrowings bear interest at SOFR or base rate plus applicable margins, with potential reductions tied to ratings, and can be prepaid without penalty. The agreement adds short-term liquidity and financial flexibility for the company.
